scripts.seed: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local -e "fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/seed',{method:'POST',headers:{'x-seed-token':process.env.SEED_TOKEN??''}}).then(r=>r.json()).then(r=>console.log(r)).catch(e=>console.error('O servidor precisa estar rodando (npm run dev).',e.message))"
scripts.db:status: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/seed').then(r=>r.json()).then(r=>console.log(r)).catch(e=>console.error('O servidor precisa estar rodando (npm run dev).',e.message))"
